text:
The company invested heavily in exposing micro-services as MCP servers, making backend systems accessible to AI agents.
This enabled agents to retrieve and correlate data across Payroll, HR, Performance Reviews, and other systems to potentially identify cost-cutting opportunities.

Here are five factors that I believe might have contributed to my selection:

1. Gratuity eligibility was just 30 days away
  • Gratuity required 4 yrs, 190 days of service. I served 4 years, 160 days, missing eligibility by just 30 days and losing several lakhs.

2. A negative written performance review
  • Received a negative review from one manager despite presenting the majority of the team's projects to stakeholders. 
  • Leadership promised to address it but never did.
